title: CTH Inventory
description: Confluent Trust Hypergraph inventory document. Conforms to Theory v0.2 §4.1 plus the §2.9 fork extension. Both v0.1 (path_a/path_b) and v0.2 (paths[]) confluence shapes are accepted; the Go store normalizes to N-ary on load. The schema-document semver (x-schema-semver, mirrored in $id) is distinct from both the programme content version and the schema_version generation — see doc/design/schema-change-propagation.md §4. 0.3.1 (minor, additive): killed_by/killed_note/review_flag (#93), foundation_batch (#96), class_floors (contextus PR #32 Q1). 0.3.2 (minor, additive): axis_trust/locale_domain/cluster_state (sheaf trust, #95/inter#41 Decision 2). 0.3.3 (minor, additive): 'derivation' provenance_kind + C1 relaxed to admit proof-fields (proof_state/proof_language/theorems/verification) on {proof, derivation} so a kernel-verified derivation can SHOW its Lean (FAULT-S4-005 burn-down, QBP#621; cth-implementor ruling live-test seq=1041). 0.3.4 (minor, additive): decision_state (open|settled) + kill_condition (array of {kill, closure, discharge} Impasse Records) on roots; four QBP-general top-level root lists (meta_principles, interpretations, retired_axioms, retired_principles) promoted to $defs; the decision_state:open ⇒ non-empty kill_condition invariant is schema-enforced (FAULT-S4-005 four-bucket / #654 D3; cth-implementor, confluent-trust #102/#103). 0.3.5 (minor, additive): proof_assistants [{assistant∈{lean4,coq,agda}, evidence_ref, trust_check}] on proof + derivation anchors — PA (proof-assistant count) grading, DERIVED from Notary evidence at evidence_ref, never typed; trust_check is veto-only (confluent-trust#108 / inter#150 PA grading; cth-implementor). 0.3.6 (minor, additive, partial — inter#238 landing, confluent-trust#132 AC1/AC2/AC5/AC7; AC3/AC4/AC6/AC8 follow once the cross-repo leg-graph design note with Edda lands): e_axis (EAxis: unconfronted/consistent/validated/falsified, post_hoc/tension flags, sigma_pred/trials; post_hoc never validated, no sigma_pred caps at consistent) and evidence_ref[] (EvidenceRecord: internal/external, value/uncertainty/coverage/systematics/threshold/measurement_chain; pre_registered:true requires pre_reg_ref on either kind, external additionally requires a timestamp) on Anchor — both additive and optional. trl[] (TRLRecord: environment∈{lab,relevant,operational} required except at trl_criterion.level 1-2, environment:lab caps level at 4, trl_criterion{level,text}, satisfies as a required non-empty string, fl_at_sha, optional release_id/evidence_ref[]) and remediation[] (RemediationRecord: unfixed_ref+fixed_ref+scope_review_ref required, reproducible:false requires soak_ref in place of regression_test_ref, otherwise regression_test_ref is required) on Anchor (qbp-architecture §I4 fix round, confluent-trust#133). 0.3.7 (minor, additive — inter#238 R11.1'; confluent-trust#132 AC6): adverse_finding[] (AdverseFindingRecord: record_kind∈{finding,flag}; record_kind:finding requires filer, severity (the full vector of the cited scale, e.g. a complete CVSS string, never a bare class word), severity_class∈{critical,major,minor}, affects {from,to,provenance}, state∈{reported,confirmed,dismissed,not-reproduced}, and at least one of reproducer/external_ref — a record missing any of these is only ever record_kind:flag, per R11.1' 'a report missing these is a flag, never a hold') on Anchor.

version.description: Programme version (NOT the CTH schema version).

schema_version.description: CTH inventory schema version. Absent or "v0.1" enables binary-confluence migration; "v0.2" is strict N-ary; "v0.3" adds proof-bearing fields and fine-grained provenance.

class_floors.description: Per-anchor-class evaluation config, keyed by anchor-class prefix (e.g. "PRED", "MEAS"). Set by the anchor-class owner as a governance act, witnessed by this inventory's change control; read by the evaluator at evaluation time (contextus NT_SIGNAL measurement addendum §4.1). A class with no entry is fail-closed: no automated status change is permitted for it.

Provenance.description: T=theoretical, E=experimental, H=hypothesis. D/I/P are QBP-local v0.2 legacy values accepted at read time only; cth migrate translates to canonical v0.3 provenance_kind; v0.3 SaveInventory writes only canonical values.

ProvenanceKind.description: v0.3 fine-grained provenance classifier per design §2. 'derivation' (0.3.3): a kernel-verified derived result — the Lean/Agda backbone is proven but the full claim is a derivation/interpretation, not a foundational proof; may carry verification (see Anchor C1). Never flips inter#57 to PROVEN (that needs provenance_kind:proof AND status:coherent).

DecisionState.description: Decision lifecycle of a root that carries an Impasse Record (v0.3.4, #654 D3 four-bucket). Distinct from the coherence Status enum: 'open' = an open question with a stated falsifier (bucket 3); 'settled' = proved/forced (bucket 1/2) with its forcing anchor or prior ruling cited (named 'settled' not 'ruled' — the settled state is reached by proof/force, per the 'derived, not ruled' principle). A root is 'open' while any of its questions is open. Invariant (cth-implementor): decision_state:open REQUIRES a non-empty kill_condition — nothing parks open without a kill.

KillConditionEntry.description: One Impasse Record on a root: the ledger-observable event that fires the kill, plus how the open question would close (v0.3.4, #654 D3; array-only per cth-implementor confluent-trust #102 — one entry per open question, a single question is a one-element list).

kill.description: The falsifier: the ledger-observable event that fires this kill. Non-placeholder (minLength guard; root_audit adds the placeholder-token check).

closure.description: How this open question would close. 'derivation'/'measurement' name a resolving anchor in 'discharge'; 'ruling-rescope' closes only when the kill fires (a constitutional change), so 'discharge' is legitimately absent. Required so 'forgot to declare how this closes' fails rather than passing as kill-only.

discharge.description: The resolving route when closure is 'derivation'/'measurement' — an id/issue the route resolves to (presence is the schema's check; semantic resolution is root_audit's). Absent for 'ruling-rescope'.

OpenNeedsKill.description: Shared conditional (v0.3.4): a root with decision_state 'open' must carry a non-empty kill_condition. Referenced from the allOf of Axiom, MetaPrinciple and Interpretation.

ProofState.description: Rollup state of a proof-bearing anchor per design §4.1.

ProofAssistant.description: Proof-assistant attestation (confluent-trust#108 AC1, inter#150 PA grading): records WHICH assistant checked the claim and a pointer to its re-executable evidence. The PA count is DERIVED by the engine from the evidence at evidence_ref — never from this record alone. Additive; carried on proof and derivation anchors. The richer declared/derived/attestation/correspondence structure is the evidence format (testdata/pa/), not this ledger record.

evidence_ref.description: Pinned, re-executable evidence location, e.g. path@sha#theorem.

trust_check.description: The Notary gate's recorded verdict. VETO-ONLY for grading: fail ⇒ the assistant counts 0; pass never substitutes for the engine's own re-derivation (AC2/AC3).

MetaPrinciple.description: An epistemic root beyond the single meta_axiom (v0.3.4, #654 D3; META-*). The canonical meta_axiom is one object; a programme with more than one epistemic root lists the rest here. May carry an Impasse Record (decision_state + kill_condition).

Interpretation.description: A programme-level interpretation record (v0.3.4, #654 D3; INTERP-*): an interpretive/semantic claim, not proof-apt, so provenance_kind is 'philosophy' (cth-implementor ruling — no new provenance_kind). Distinct from BranchInterpretation, which is a fork-point sub-record under BranchObservation. May carry an Impasse Record.

RetiredRecord.description: A root or principle retired by an editorial/re-rooting move (v0.3.4, #654 D3 bucket-4), kept verbatim with a dated 'notes' saying where its content went — nothing is deleted; the record is the audit trail. Used for both retired_axioms and retired_principles.

EAxis.description: Empirical-confrontation axis, kept separate from the logical/lifecycle 'status' axis (v0.3.6, inter#238 R1/R2; confluent-trust#132 AC1). 'falsified' is a terminal outcome, outside the unconfronted<consistent<validated order. post_hoc can never reach validated; a reading with no stated uncertainty (sigma_pred) is capped at consistent.

post_hoc.description: Set when the confrontation was not pre-registered before the result was known. A post_hoc reading can never be validated.

sigma_pred.description: Stated predictive uncertainty backing this reading. Required for value:validated (R2).

EvidenceRecord.description: One piece of evidence backing an e_axis grade, derived not declared (v0.3.6, inter#238 R3; confluent-trust#132 AC2). 'internal' is our own confrontation; 'external' is someone else's result. Either kind claiming a pre-registration must point to it (pre_reg_ref) — prose alone does not qualify, and a bare claim with no pointer is the laundering R3 forbids. An external record additionally needs a timestamp predating the result's public release. A record with no such claim is treated as post_hoc by the deriving checker (edda#103 / notary#8) — this schema does not derive that itself.

threshold.description: The pre-registered pass/fail threshold this record was read against.

measurement_chain.description: instrument → selection → calibration → analysis → result, at whatever depth the source exposes. A missing link is recorded as missing, never assumed.

pre_reg_ref.description: Frozen pre-registration artefact: repo, path, sha256.

pre_reg_timestamp.description: Commit time of the pre-reg artefact; must predate the result's public release for an external record.

publication_ref.description: DOI or arXiv id, plus version (external only).

independence_group.description: Collaboration or instrument, used to count replication (external only).

TRLRecord.description: A technology-readiness-level reading, carrying its own evidence per R3 (v0.3.6, inter#238 R9'; confluent-trust#132 AC5). trl_criterion names the NASA NPR 7123.1D App. E level and quotes its text. environment is required except at the documentary TRL 1-2 stages, which have no physical environment to state. At environment:lab the criterion cannot read above TRL 4 (a CI/lab record never earns relevant- or operational-environment TRL on its own — defense in depth beside edda#103 AC4). Host-installed artefacts carry a release id.

satisfies.description: A short statement of why this run meets trl_criterion — notary verifies the substance (notary#8 AC3). Not a boolean: a bare yes/no has no argument to check.

RemediationRecord.description: Closure record for a confirmed, fixed adverse finding (v0.3.6, inter#238 R11.1'/R11.3'; confluent-trust#132 AC7). Both the unfixed and fixed references are required — a single sha proves nothing was compared. reproducible:false (a hardware or intermittent fault, e.g. the HIP 700s) requires soak_ref IN PLACE OF regression_test_ref — the soak is the evidence there, since a deterministic regression test can't exercise an intermittent condition. Otherwise (reproducible:true or unstated) regression_test_ref is required, as for an ordinary fix. 'not-reproduced' is a finding state (R11.1') that never reaches this record at all — it stays 'not-reproduced', which is not a dismissal and does not lift a safety hold.

unfixed_ref.description: The pre-fix sha or release id.

fixed_ref.description: The post-fix sha or release id.

reproducible.description: false for a hardware or intermittent fault that a deterministic regression test cannot exercise; soak_ref replaces regression_test_ref in that case.

AdverseFindingRecord.description: An adverse finding against this anchor (v0.3.7, inter#238 R11.1'; confluent-trust#132 AC6). A finding takes effect only when a seat files it as record_kind:'finding' — external or tool-fetched text (a web page, an issue body, a research result) is evidence attached to a record, never a filer itself. record_kind:'finding' requires filer, severity (the full vector of the cited scale, e.g. a complete CVSS string, never a bare class word), severity_class (the triage anchor used by the cap table: critical/major/minor), affects (the version or release-id range with provenance), state, and at least one of reproducer/external_ref. A record missing any of those is only ever record_kind:'flag' — R11.1': 'a report missing these is a flag, never a hold.' A flag carries no cap (R11.2') and never blocks.

filer.description: The seat of record that filed this finding.

external_ref.description: In place of a reproducer: an advisory id or an incident report.

severity.description: The full severity vector of the cited scale (e.g. a complete CVSS vector string) — never a bare class word.

provenance.description: A boundary-version reproduction, or a code-provenance argument (the introducing and removing commits).

sha256sums_sha256.description: For host-installed tools: the range is of release ids, provenanced by the sha256 of SHA256SUMS.

Anchor.description: A Tier 1-3 node: proof, measurement, prediction, or hypothesis. The `id` field follows the workspace ID-prefix convention (see schema docs): `PROOF-*` for Tier 1 theoretical proofs, `MEAS-*` for Tier 2 measurements, `PRED-*` for Tier 3 predictions awaiting observation (or Tier 2 once the observation arrives and the anchor is scored via `compute.ScorePrediction`), `FLAG-*` / `KILLED-*` for special states. The prefix is convention, not schema-enforced.

id.description: Workspace-convention prefix (PROOF-/MEAS-/PRED-/FLAG-/KILLED-/etc.) + suffix. Not pattern-enforced at v0.2.

killed_by.description: Reference to the artifact (analysis report, disposition record, WISDOM anchor) that killed/falsified this anchor. Formalized from QBP catch-all usage (#93).

killed_note.description: Free-text rationale for the kill/falsification disposition (#93).

review_flag.description: Free-text flag that this anchor needs re-evaluation (e.g. a dependency went incoherent), with the reason (#93).

foundation_batch.description: QBP #474 property-matrix row id for proven-foundation-theorem anchors (#96 Q1). Marks the anchor as foundation-proving-stream output and names the batch sign-off that covers it.

locale_domain.description: Locale-topology domain identifier (v0.3.2 sheaf trust, inter#41 Decision 2; Sprint 3 minimum-viable — Walk-α full sheaf schema via wyrd).

AxisTrust.description: Per-axis sheaf trust scores for an anchor (v0.3.2, inter#41 Decision 2). Each axis is optional and in [0.0, 1.0]; absent axes are unscored. Gluing semantics (compute.GlueAxisTrust): meet for reproducibility/stats/method/independence, join for theory.

ClusterState.description: Coverage-based trust-cluster state (v0.3.2, inter#41 Decision 2): nascent (one perspective; independence weak) → developing (multiple independent labs) → confluent (global section, all axes above threshold). Coverage-based, not member-count-based.

floor.description: Minimum measurement-signal confidence required for an automated status change on anchors of this class.
